blocks.title: Mitigate upstream
blocks.text: A distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack aims to exhaust bandwidth or service resources. Upstream rate-limiting, DDoS protection and filtering may reduce impact; encrypting the website does not stop resource saturation.

questions.prompt: Choose the response that best addresses this independent task: FOUNDATION · QUESTION 1 OF 3 Explain how phishing differs from malware and give one example of each. [6]
questions.answer: Phishing deceives a user into divulging information or performing an action [3]; malware is malicious software with a damaging/unauthorised function, e.g. ransomware [3].
options: DDoS upstream mitigation [2], account containment/MFA/reset [2], differing threat mechanism [2], defence-in-depth explanation [2].
